title: ChatHealthy FDA Product To Diagnosis Resolution
description: ChatHealthy's FDA drug collection at the MOLECULE grain (EPIC-010-F-007, LLD v83 III.4.1): one document per molecule, _id == molecule_id, assembling the molecule's SPL labels. Each label folds in exactly once; set_ids carries the contributing labels' set_ids, and a label whose set_id is already present is disregarded as already processed. OTC-only labels are excluded from the built output (retained in staging). The molecule master and the enrich path join to this record by molecule_id -- a point lookup on _id.

_id.description: == molecule_id; the collection is keyed on the molecule.

molecule_id.description: Proprietary molecule surrogate (LLD v83 III.3 decision #2). Never shown to a user.

set_ids.description: The FDA SPL set_ids of the labels folded into this record -- the contributing record keys. A label folds in at most once. This array exists ONLY in this collection (operator ruling 2026-10-20).

clean_names.description: Clean molecule name(s) unioned across the molecule's labels.

rxcui.description: openfda.rxcui unioned across labels, when present.

unii.description: openfda.unii unioned across labels, when present.

substance_name.description: openfda.substance_name unioned across labels, when present.

_molecule_sources.description: Provenance of the clean molecule name(s), unioned across the folded labels.

label_brand_names.description: The brand names on the molecule's labels, first-seen order, folded case-insensitively. The first rung of the RxNorm identity ladder resolves from these.

label_generic_names.description: The generic names on the molecule's labels, first-seen order, folded case-insensitively. The second rung of the identity ladder resolves from these.

indications.description: On-label indications unioned across the molecule's labels, deduplicated by normalized indication text, ICD-10 codes unioned by code and split to level3/level4.

raw_text.description: FDA indication wording (indications_and_usage, or package_label_principal_display_panel fallback).

level4.description: 4-char ICD-10-CM codes (may be empty). Level 5 not carried.

trust.description: Exact decimal. Python computes it as decimal.Decimal and MongoDB stores it as Decimal128 (bsonType decimal); never a binary float. JSON has no decimal type, so this contract declares the field a string.

name.description: The canonical indication's plain-language name. Present on an entry the judged pass produced.

source_texts.description: Every verbatim label wording this canonical indication absorbed. Each wording appears in exactly one entry's source_texts.

summarized_usage.description: Summarized usage, unioned across the folded labels.

classes.description: SET across the molecule's labels: a molecule can carry both OTC and Rx labels. UNDETERMINED never defaulted.

trust.description: Aggregate of the folded labels' resolution confidence (model confidence where resolution was inferred).

max.description: Exact decimal, as the measure it is computed over. Python computes it as decimal.Decimal and MongoDB stores it as Decimal128 (bsonType decimal); never a binary float. JSON has no decimal type, so this contract declares the field a string.

min.description: Exact decimal, as the measure it is computed over. Python computes it as decimal.Decimal and MongoDB stores it as Decimal128 (bsonType decimal); never a binary float. JSON has no decimal type, so this contract declares the field a string.

median.description: Exact decimal, as the measure it is computed over. Python computes it as decimal.Decimal and MongoDB stores it as Decimal128 (bsonType decimal); never a binary float. JSON has no decimal type, so this contract declares the field a string.

avg.description: Exact decimal, as the measure it is computed over. Python computes it as decimal.Decimal and MongoDB stores it as Decimal128 (bsonType decimal); never a binary float. JSON has no decimal type, so this contract declares the field a string.

rxcui_in.description: The RxNorm ingredient RXCUI this molecule resolves to (RXNCONSO TTY=IN). The identifier the provider and specialty collections join on. Absent when the identity ladder resolves nothing.

unii.description: The FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier of that ingredient, read from its MTHSPL TTY=SU row's CODE. FDA assigns a UNII permanently and never reuses it, so it is the immutable identity.

identity_path.description: Which rung of the identity ladder answered: the CMS or label brand name, or the generic name.

identity_also.description: The further ingredients a combination brand reaches beyond the first, so nothing resolved is dropped.

label_classes.description: One entry per contributing label: its own drug class and openFDA product type. drug_class on the molecule is the union across these, so the per-label entry is what says whether a given product needed a prescription.
